ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: GoLandly uses the camera so you can take a profile picture.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: GoLandly uses Face ID so you can unlock the app quickly and keep your passes private.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GoLandly uses your photos so you can choose a profile picture.
